verification_steps: Export job acquired each exact provider-native job artifact ZIP via authenticated same-project API
Exporter checked ZIP CRC and emitted small Base64 chunks and source SHA-256
Archived Base64 content committed to ASES on GitHub
Independent verification fetched the GitHub copy, decoded to byte arrays, validated standard SHA-256 test vectors, and recomputed each ZIP SHA-256 and byte length
archive_completeness_scope: Complete original job-uploaded artifact ZIPs only; not complete original GitLab job traces and all provider metadata
limitations: A hash check proves byte identity, not the factual correctness of an underlying assertion or interpretation
The initial failed run exited before writing results/p6.json; its native artifact only contains environment and empty summary
The GitLab job traces contain provider infrastructure data and are not copied into the public repo without review
